title: Coffin Bay National Park
get_in:
The park is a little more than a half-hour drive from [[Port Lincoln]], the regional centre of the Eyre Peninsula. From Port Lincoln, head south on B100 which will eventually head west once you leave town. After about {{km|30}}, there will be a turnoff into Coffin Bay Road with signs to Coffin Bay National Park. Follow those signs into Coffin Bay for about 14 km and turn left onto Long Beach Road. You've then arrived at the park.

If you're coming from further afield, the turnoff to Coffin Bay is the same no matter which road you're coming from with the difference being how long you'll be travelling on B100 for.
